_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'WBS DICTIONARY' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.02.07.

f01_WBS_Identifier_and_Title.label: WBS Identifier and Title
f01_WBS_Identifier_and_Title.guidance: The unique WBS code number and descriptive name of the specific work package.

f02_Control_Account_and_Responsible_Orga.label: Control Account and Responsible Organization
f02_Control_Account_and_Responsible_Orga.guidance: Associated control account code and organizational unit or person accountable for delivery.

f03_Work_Package_Owner.label: Work Package Owner
f03_Work_Package_Owner.guidance: Designated lead engineer or manager responsible for work package execution.

f04_Work_Package_Scope_Description.label: Work Package Scope Description
f04_Work_Package_Scope_Description.guidance: Detailed narrative describing the technical work, tasks, and activities required for this package.

f05_Deliverables_Produced.label: Deliverables Produced
f05_Deliverables_Produced.guidance: Specific tangible or intangible outputs generated upon work package completion.

f06_Milestone_Schedule_and_Target_Dates.label: Milestone Schedule and Target Dates
f06_Milestone_Schedule_and_Target_Dates.guidance: Target start date, intermediate technical milestones, and completion deadline.

f07_Quality_Requirements_and_Standards.label: Quality Requirements and Standards
f07_Quality_Requirements_and_Standards.guidance: Mandatory quality metrics, engineering specifications, and technical standards.

f08_Acceptance_Criteria_and_Sign_off_Lea.label: Acceptance Criteria and Sign-off Lead
f08_Acceptance_Criteria_and_Sign_off_Lea.guidance: Clear criteria and designated stakeholder authorized to accept the work package.

f09_Required_Resources_and_Skills.label: Required Resources and Skills
f09_Required_Resources_and_Skills.guidance: Personnel roles, technical expertise, materials, and specialized equipment needed.

f10_Cost_Estimate_and_Budget_Allocation.label: Cost Estimate and Budget Allocation
f10_Cost_Estimate_and_Budget_Allocation.guidance: Approved budget allocation and cost baseline figure assigned to this work package.

f11_Assumptions_Constraints_and_Dependen.label: Assumptions, Constraints, and Dependencies
f11_Assumptions_Constraints_and_Dependen.guidance: Specific operational constraints, key assumptions, and preceding/succeeding work package linkages.
